module rtlpp_00785 (
   count, fired, clk, rst_n, eop, char_in, enable, char_in_vld, stream_id, new_stream_id, load_state
   );

    input clk, rst_n;
    input eop;
    input load_state;
    input [7:0] char_in;
    input enable;
    input char_in_vld;
    input [5:0] stream_id;
    input new_stream_id;
    
    output [15:0] count;
    output fired;
    
    reg [15:0] count;
    reg [15:0] speculative_match;
    
    reg [10:0] state_mem [0:63];
    reg state_in_vld;
    reg [10:0] state_in;
    
    wire accept_out;
    wire [10:0] state_out;

    assign fired = speculative_match;

    // Internal Logic for State and Acceptance

    reg [7:0] state;
    reg [7:0] next_state;
    reg accept;

    always @(*) begin
        accept = 0;
        next_state = state;
        if (char_in_vld) begin
            // Example state transition logic
            case(state)
                8'h00: next_state = (char_in == 8'h41) ? 8'h01 : 8'h00;
                8'h01: next_state = (char_in == 8'h42) ? 8'h02 : 8'h00;
                8'h02: begin
                    next_state = 8'h00;
                    accept = 1;
                end
                default: next_state = 8'h00;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n)
            state <= 8'h00;
        else if (state_in_vld)
            state <= state_in[7:0];
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    assign state_out = {3'b000, state}; // Aligning state to 11 bits
    assign accept_out = accept;

    // Main Control Logic

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            count <= 0;
            speculative_match <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (load_state)
                speculative_match <= 0;

            if (accept_out)
                speculative_match <= 1;

            if (eop) begin
                if (enable) begin
                    count <= count + speculative_match;
                    state_mem[stream_id] <= state_out;
                end else
                    speculative_match <= 0;
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        state_in_vld <= 0;
        if (load_state) begin    
            if (new_stream_id) begin
                state_in <= 11'h000;
                state_in_vld <= 1;
            end else begin
                state_in <= state_mem[stream_id];
                state_in_vld <= 1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
